partners.mechanism_chain: MYO6 (HGNC:7742) —DISRUPTS→ hair cell stereocilia mechanotransduction (GO:0000303); hair cell stereocilia mechanotransduction (GO:0000303) —LEADS_TO→ hearing impairment (HP:0000365); PAK2 (HGNC:8564) —DISRUPTS→ cytoskeletal organization (GO:0007010); cytoskeletal organization (GO:0007010) —LEADS_TO→ cell adhesion (GO:0007155); cell adhesion (GO:0007155) —LEADS_TO→ occipital encephalocele (HP:0002090); cell adhesion (GO:0007155) —LEADS_TO→ ocular abnormalities (HP:0000478). Concurrently, mutations in PAK2 disrupt cytoskeletal organization, which in turn affects cell adhesion, ultimately contributing to phenotypes such as occipital encephalocele and ocular abnormalities seen in Knobloch syndrome 2. #### 1. autosomal dominant nonsyndromic hearing loss 22  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.500)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-9013420, Reactome:R-HSA-9013422, Reactome:R-HSA-190873, Reactome:R-HSA-399719, Reactome:R-HSA-9013418)

**How to falsify it:** Identification of individuals with pathogenic variants in MYO6 exhibiting a phenotype entirely distinct from hearing impairment, or the absence of hearing impairment in individuals with known pathogenic MYO6 variants. _(variant: rs141463652)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of MYO6 in hearing loss could enable the development of gene-targeted therapies applicable to both the recessive and dominant forms of nonsyndromic hearing loss.

Pathogenic variants in GJB2 disrupt the formation and function of gap junctions in cochlear hair cells, leading to impaired intercellular communication essential for hearing. This disruption ultimately results in hearing impairment in both diseases.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of pathogenic variants in GJB2 that are exclusively associated with one disease and not the other, or demonstration that the functional consequence of GJB2 variants differs significantly between the two disease contexts. _(variant: rs757758280)_

**Why it matters:** Targeting GJB2 gene therapy or connexin-based therapeutics could potentially address the shared molecular defect underlying both hearing loss conditions.

This disruption leads to hearing impairment in nonsyndromic hearing loss 37 and contributes to short stature and lipodystrophy in SHORT syndrome.

**How to falsify it:** Demonstration that MYO6 and PAK2 function in completely independent and non-interacting cellular pathways with no downstream overlap in cytoskeletal regulation or cell adhesion mechanisms, or identification of pathogenic variants in MYO6 or PAK2 with a sufficiently high allele frequency (>1%) in gnomAD populations inconsistent with a rare disease cause. _(variant: rs113701456)_
